objective: Determine the exact deduplicated stable-ID union of the eight accepted OATD candidate gates before any candidate detail hydration.

algebraic_candidate_union.identity: (P AND M_H) OR (P AND M_B AND E_F) OR (P AND M_B AND E_H) OR (P AND M_B AND R) OR (P AND M_B AND T_precise) OR (P AND G_model) OR (P AND G_structure) OR (P AND C1)

source_safety.adapter_busy_retry_scope: one explicit busy response after 120 seconds

acceptance_checks: Every gate has two complete source-rendered card-ID passes.
Each gate has equal stable-ID sets across its two passes.
Every gate has exact query and shared-control readback.
No Record Details page is requested.
Each gate has a configured-search and verified-results screenshot.
Each gate JSON and both screenshots are bound by a terminal marker.
The cross-gate union preserves gate membership and source rank.
A failed gate leaves the exact candidate union null.
